lead_independence.headline: Body believed to be missing Port St. Lucie man found in Martin County mangroves near House of Refuge
lead_independence.lead: A body was recovered from deep within the mangroves near the House of Refuge in Martin County on Tuesday following an extensive search for a man reported missing Aug. 27. Martin County Sheriff John Budensiek said a Good Samaritan found a wallet Saturday belonging to Michael Anthony Debevec. In an attempt to return the wallet, the Good Samaritan went to Debevec's home, which led his family to file a missing person report. Investigators found Debevec's vehicle Saturday afternoon at Chastain Beach, more than two miles from where the body was discovered.
